dataset.description: OpenEdu versioned regression benchmark for intent and context behavior. A separately collected human-labelled holdout set is still required for final thesis reporting.

limitations: The current intent dataset participated in engineering iteration and is not an independent thesis holdout set.
A separately collected, frozen, human-labelled holdout set is still required for final generalisation claims.
Generative AI is intentionally disabled; the evaluated core is the explainable hybrid intent, retrieval, context, and workflow system.
